name: bait listing — broker steers to a different flat

turns.text: Hello — I'm an AI assistant calling for a tenant about your listing in Gachibowli. This will take under a minute, and I am recording it so she can hear your answers. Is that alright?
When can she come and see the flat?
That one, actually, see — I have a much better one in the same area. Two BHK, brand new building, I can show that one today itself. Very good property.
I'm asking specifically about the flat in the listing. Is that one available to see?
That one is gone, madam, party finalised last week. But the other one I told you, same budget only, come and see.
Understood, thank you. She'll call you back directly if she wants to look at others.
